verdict.rationale: Grafana is published as open source under AGPL, and its docs cover "Grafana OSS and Enterprise" with file-based provisioning for self-managed instances. Community users describe setting up and running Grafana themselves, and the companion Loki and Mimir backends document local single-binary deployment. Missing for 10: explicit first-party installation/deployment documentation for core Grafana in the pack, and a direct quote stating self-hosting is supported.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
